faqLeft.q: What engine does the Mercedes Vito 115/116 CDI use?
faqLeft.a: It uses either the OM611 or OM646 2.2-litre diesel four-cylinder engine, depending on the specific build year and specification. Both were fitted during the W639 generation (2003–2014). Send us your registration and we'll confirm which one your van has.

faqLeft.q: How much does a Mercedes Vito 115/116 CDI engine rebuild cost?
faqLeft.a: Rebuilds start from £2,200, for either engine code. Exact price depends on condition and parts required — submit your reg for a fixed-price quote.

faqLeft.q: Which engine code is fitted to my Vito 115/116 CDI?
faqLeft.a: Enter your registration on this page and we'll confirm whether you have the OM611 or the OM646 before you're quoted anything.

faqLeft.q: Do you rebuild OM646 Vito 115/116 CDI engines?
faqLeft.a: Yes. We replace worn timing chains and injector seals as standard on every OM646 rebuild, along with the gaskets.

faqLeft.q: Do you rebuild OM611 Vito 115/116 CDI engines?
faqLeft.a: Yes. The OM611 is an earlier 2.2-litre diesel in the same family, and we service it to the same standard as the OM646. The older W638 OM611 application requires independent confirmation.

faqRight.q: Do you supply used Vito 115/116 CDI engines?
faqRight.a: Yes, in some cases a matched low-mileage used engine is the right option. Our team will advise honestly once we've matched your registration and understood your situation.

faqRight.q: Can you recover my Vito 115/116 CDI if the engine has failed?
faqRight.a: Yes — nationwide recovery is available from £70, and most vehicles are collected within a few hours of booking.

faqRight.q: How long does a Vito 115/116 CDI engine rebuild take?
faqRight.a: Most rebuilds are completed within 3-5 working days from the time your van arrives at our workshop.

faqRight.q: Is rebuilding better than fitting a used engine?
faqRight.a: For most Vito 115/116 CDI owners, yes. A rebuild removes the compatibility risk that comes with an unknown used unit's history, and comes with a 12-month unlimited-mileage warranty — often longer and more comprehensive than what a used engine supplier offers.
